sharedCorrections.original: The traveler watched the futures unfold.
The lost futures left nothing behind.
The memories were lost by chance.
sharedCorrections.corrected: Someone attempted to erase them deliberately.

sharedCorrections.original: The Severing was an unexplained catastrophe.
sharedCorrections.corrected: The conflict over memory and fate caused the Severing.

sharedCorrections.original: Time continued unchanged after the Severing.
sharedCorrections.corrected: Time fragmented into loops, jumps, and broken sequences.

sharedCorrections.original: Their stories had reached an ending.
sharedCorrections.corrected: Something in the Weave refused the ending.
He survived in a fused existence with the Being.

sharedCorrections.original: The narrator was only a historian.
sharedCorrections.corrected: The narrator is the Forgotten Observer.
